description: Fix the goal-host restart race in repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/vessel-mitosis-cutover.ts. In the goal-host branch of the restart step (the block starting with the comment "Drain to <=1, not <=0"), the drain polls goal-host /health in_flight BEFORE scheduling the deferred restart, and the transient systemd-run unit then executes a bare "systemctl restart" that fires blind ~30 seconds later — any dispatch that arrived or started during that window is killed, and when the bounded wait expires the restart proceeds regardless of in-flight count. The sibling dev-vessel self-restart branch just above already does this correctly: its transient unit runs a shell script that polls in-flight AT FIRE TIME in a bounded loop and only then execs systemctl restart. Change the goal-host branch to use the same pattern: move the in_flight <= 1 quiesce loop INSIDE the transient unit's shell script (poll the goal-host /health endpoint with a bounded iteration count, break when in_flight <= 1, treat a missing in_flight field as NOT quiet rather than quiet), and keep the existing deferred systemd-run mechanism. Do not change the dev-vessel branch.
